properties.name: cpf.integration.resilience.enabled
properties.description: Enables the CPF integration resilience starter.

properties.name: cpf.integration.resilience.engine.guard-idle-ttl
properties.description: Idle retention for unused resilience guard state before bounded eviction.

properties.name: cpf.integration.resilience.engine.maximum-guard-entries
properties.description: Maximum cardinality of revision-aware circuit/rate/bulkhead guard state retained by one engine.

properties.name: cpf.integration.resilience.locking.jdbc-provider-enabled
properties.description: Enables the distributed JDBC lock provider. Requires cpf_lock_shard rows 0..255 and cpf_distributed_lock vendor migrations.

properties.name: cpf.integration.resilience.locking.local-provider-enabled
properties.description: Enables the single-JVM in-memory lock provider for tests or explicitly single-instance runtimes only. Do not combine with the JDBC provider.

properties.name: cpf.integration.resilience.locking.local.maximum-tracked-keys
properties.description: Maximum distinct lock keys whose tombstone and fencing history the single-JVM provider retains. New keys fail closed at the limit; history is never evicted or reused.

properties.name: cpf.integration.resilience.runtime.attempt-timeout
properties.description: Maximum duration of one resilience attempt.

properties.name: cpf.integration.resilience.runtime.bulkhead.queue-limit
properties.description: Maximum number of requests waiting behind the bulkhead.

properties.name: cpf.integration.resilience.runtime.bulkhead.queue-wait
properties.description: Maximum bulkhead queue wait, capped by the overall deadline.

properties.name: cpf.integration.resilience.runtime.connect-timeout
properties.description: Global outbound TCP connect timeout; operation-specific properties override this value.

properties.name: cpf.integration.resilience.runtime.overall-timeout
properties.description: End-to-end deadline including bulkhead wait, attempts and backoff.

properties.name: cpf.integration.resilience.runtime.read-timeout
properties.description: Global response-body read timeout.

properties.name: cpf.integration.resilience.runtime.response-header-timeout
properties.description: Global response-header timeout before response-body reads begin.

properties.name: cpf.integration.resilience.runtime.retry.budget-capacity
properties.description: Retry permits per retry budget window.

properties.name: cpf.integration.resilience.runtime.retry.budget-window
properties.description: Retry budget window.

properties.name: cpf.integration.resilience.runtime.retry.initial-backoff
properties.description: Initial exponential retry backoff.

properties.name: cpf.integration.resilience.runtime.retry.jitter-ratio
properties.description: Bounded retry jitter ratio from 0.0 through 1.0.

properties.name: cpf.integration.resilience.runtime.retry.max-backoff
properties.description: Maximum exponential retry backoff.

properties.name: cpf.integration.resilience.runtime.tls-timeout
properties.description: Global TLS handshake timeout.

properties.name: cpf.integration.resilience.runtime.write-timeout
properties.description: Global outbound request write timeout.

properties.name: cpf.integration.resilience.state.jdbc-provider-enabled
properties.description: Enables the shared JDBC operation-state provider. Requires the cpf-state-db vendor install/upgrade scripts and shard rows 0..257.

properties.name: cpf.integration.resilience.state.jdbc.command-ttl
properties.description: Retention window for durable operation-id deduplication rows; must be positive and no greater than 365 days.

properties.name: cpf.integration.resilience.state.jdbc.maximum-commands
properties.description: Maximum retained idempotency command rows after TTL pruning.

properties.name: cpf.integration.resilience.state.jdbc.maximum-states
properties.description: Maximum durable operation-state rows. New states fail closed at the limit while existing states remain updateable.

properties.name: cpf.reconciliation.worker.id
properties.description: Stable reconciliation worker identity used for claims, locks, state transitions and audit.
